issues.legal_issue: Interest on compensation later enhanced by a court runs from the date possession is taken at the applicable rate, rather than beginning at a lower rate and increasing only from the date of the later judgment.
material_facts: Compensation for acquired land was first determined by the Land Acquisition Officer and later enhanced by the District Judge and the High Court.

The High Court held that the amended higher rate of interest applied to the pending compensation proceedings and applied that rate from the date possession was taken to the compensation previously determined by the Land Acquisition Officer and District Judge.
For the additional compensation awarded by the High Court, the High Court applied the lower rate from the date possession was taken and the higher rate only from the date of its judgment.
issues.conclusion: The enhanced compensation was entitled to interest at the higher applicable rate from the date possession was taken until payment; the appeal was allowed and the High Court’s order modified accordingly.
issues.legal_principle: Under sections 28 and 34 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894, as amended by the Haryana Act No. 8 of 1967, the applicable higher rate of interest applied to the compensation. The right to compensation arises when the land is acquired, while later court decisions merely quantify that right. The further compensation awarded by a court represents the shortfall between the amount previously awarded and the land’s true value; determining that amount later does not mean the right to it arose later. No earlier cases are relied on.

rule.if: land_acquisition_compensation_proceeding and possession_taken_before_final_quantification and appellate_court_enhanced_compensation and higher_rate_applied_to_prior_compensation

predicates.land_acquisition_compensation_proceeding: A proceeding determines compensation payable for land acquired by the State.
predicates.possession_taken_before_final_quantifica: The acquiring authority took possession of the land before the compensation was finally quantified.
predicates.appellate_court_enhanced_compensation: A court reviewing an earlier compensation determination awarded additional compensation.
predicates.higher_rate_applied_to_prior_compensatio: The court held that a higher applicable interest rate governed compensation already determined at an earlier stage.
predicates.enhanced_compensation_interest_runs_from: Interest on compensation added by a reviewing court runs from the date possession was taken at the higher applicable rate.

issues.definition: When compensation in a land-acquisition proceeding is enhanced after possession has been taken, and the higher rate governs previously determined compensation, interest on the added compensation runs from possession at that same rate.
